decisions.reason: The shop relaunch SEO service has had a page of its own for two consecutive years and fits the firm's core SEO and e-commerce consulting competence, so it appears to meet aspirations and needs little slack to maintain. Dropping the three plugins suggests the firm is refocusing on services rather than cutting this offering.

The SEO workshops were launched only in 2024 as part of the firm's search-driven shift toward consulting services, and their results are still uncertain. Their low marginal cost and fit with the firm's existing SEO expertise make it likely management carries them for at least another year.
